subject: Important Information Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for submitting your application for the Marketing Coordinator position at our company. We wanted to inform you that we have received your application and are currently reviewing all the candidates. Our hiring team will be in touch with you within the next two weeks to provide an update on the status of your application. In the meantime, feel free to reach out if you have any questions. Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
